description: Build the prototype shell, design-system foundation, and the HERO screens that must be jaw-dropping: an animated BRIT loader -> cinematic Login -> the Dashboard masthead experience. This feature establishes everything the rest of the app reuses: the self-contained file structure under docs/mobile-prototype/, the full .brit-room design-token CSS (copied verbatim from mgsr-web/src/app/globals.css), the paper-grain overlay, Oswald/Manrope/DM Mono typography with system fallbacks, the realistic phone-frame showcase/index page, a lightweight hash-based screen router with slide/fade transitions, the fixed mobile top header + bottom tab bar + 'More' bottom sheet navigation model (extended from mgsr-web/src/components/mobile), the sliding Men/Youth/Women platform switch that retints the whole UI, and the signature BritLoader. This is the backbone + the two most important wow moments (dashboard + login).
steps: Create docs/mobile-prototype/ with: index.html (showcase launcher that renders the running app inside a realistic iPhone-style phone frame — rounded corners, notch/dynamic-island, status bar, home indicator — on an editorial paper/ink backdrop, with a short art-direction caption and buttons to jump to key screens), styles.css (all design-system + component CSS), app.js (data + router + screen render + interactions), and an assets/ folder for inline SVG where helpful. A single-file approach is acceptable but prefer the split for readability. Use ONLY relative paths so it works from file:// and from GitHub Pages /mocks.

In styles.css, define the .brit-room design tokens VERBATIM from mgsr-web/src/app/globals.css: --ink:#161613; --black:#11110f; --paper:#f3f0e8; --paper-2:#e4ded1; --card:#fbf9f3; --gold:#a47d43; --gold-soft:#c9a66b; --red:#b64235; --green:#5c6f4a; --amber:#b07a2b; --blue:#4a5f6f; --muted:#77736a; --muted-2:#aba69b; --line:rgba(22,22,19,.18); --line-2:rgba(22,22,19,.07); --dark-line:rgba(243,240,232,.2). Set --display:'Oswald',Impact,sans-serif; --body:'Manrope',Helvetica,sans-serif; --mono:'DM Mono',monospace. Add the fixed fractalNoise paper-grain overlay (reuse the exact SVG data-URI from globals.css at ~0.045 opacity). Link Google Fonts for Oswald/Manrope/DM Mono in index.html <head> with system fallbacks so offline still renders.

Define platform retint theming driven by a data-platform attribute on the app root: men = gold (default tokens), youth = override --gold:#2f7d6e; --gold-soft:#5fa391; --gold-bright:#8fc9b8 (pitch teal 'Academy'), women = rose --gold:#b05f7e; --gold-soft:#E8A0BF (ATHENA, empowering tone). Keep all component CSS referencing var(--gold)/var(--gold-soft) so a single attribute swap retints the whole UI, mirroring how globals.css does the youth retint.

Build the app chrome: a fixed top header (BRIT circle logo mark as inline SVG + 'BRIT' kicker + workspace/desk label + current page title + a notification bell button + the platform switch), and a fixed bottom tab bar (Dashboard, Players, War Room, Tasks) + a 'More' button opening a bottom-sheet 3-column icon grid (Shortlist, Market Radar, Releases, Club Changes, Contract Finisher, Returnees, Contacts, Requests, AI Scout, Chat/The Tunnel) with a drag handle and slide-up animation. Reuse the inline icon SVGs from mgsr-web/src/components/mobile/MobileBottomTabBar.tsx and MoreSheet.tsx. The bottom sheet closes on backdrop tap and drag-down.

Implement the sliding platform switch as a pill with a thumb that glides between Men/Youth/Women stops (transition transform .42s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.2,1)) and recolors to the active platform accent, matching .brit-platform-switch in globals.css. Selecting a platform sets data-platform on the app root (retinting everything) and ideally updates the dashboard desk label (MANAGEMENT ROOM / ACADEMY DESK / ATHENA DESK).

Implement a lightweight hash/state-based screen router in app.js: screens are rendered into a single app viewport inside the phone frame; navigating pushes onto a history stack and animates the incoming screen (horizontal slide for push, fade for tab switches) with CSS transitions; a back affordance in the header pops the stack. Keep it dependency-free and performant on a phone (use transform/opacity transitions only).

Build the signature BritLoader screen (first-run splash before login): 3 concentric spinning rings (gold / ink / gold, counter-rotating) + a pulsing glowing core + a horizontal shimmer line + 'BRIT SPORT GROUP' Oswald title + 'MANAGEMENT ROOM' subtitle + three pulsing dots, on a cream (#f5f1e8 -> #faf7f0) background — port from BritLoader.css. Auto-advance to Login after ~2s (and reuse this loader as the transition state into other heavy screens like the matchday generator).

Build a cinematic Login screen: full-bleed editorial composition — big Oswald masthead (e.g. 'THE MANAGEMENT ROOM' / 'BRIT SPORT GROUP'), gold hairline rules, a mono kicker, a grayscale editorial backdrop with dark scrim, understated email/password fields styled as hairline-underline editorial inputs, a gold 'ENTER THE ROOM' primary action, and the platform switch. Submitting (any input) runs the BritLoader transition then lands on the Dashboard. This is a hero screen — make it feel like a private members' club entrance, not a generic form.

Build the HERO Dashboard screen reimagined for mobile (the single most important wow moment), following MenDashboard.tsx section order but re-laid-out as a vertically scrolling mobile canvas: (a) masthead with a mono kicker + huge Oswald 'GOOD MORNING, LIOR.' with a gold-accented word + a tiny mono date/location note (Asia/Jerusalem); (b) a horizontal 'signals' stat strip (e.g. PLAYERS, SHORTLISTS, WITHOUT CLUB, pending count) using big Oswald numbers + mono labels + a red accent for urgent; (c) a 'TODAY' birthdays/deadlines module (brit-deadline rows with a gold code, player name, agent, and a WISH action button); (d) an 'OUR ASSETS' horizontally-scrolling focus marquee of grayscale player cards with dark bottom scrim + name overlay (brit-focus treatment) that tap through to the dossier; (e) a 'MATCHWEEK' horizontal timeline rail of upcoming fixtures with opponent crest markers, countdown pills, and a glowing 'next' stop (brit-matchweek); (f) a dark #11110f 'PENDING DECISIONS' black module (brit-approval rows: grayscale thumb, name, context, APPROVE action); (g) a 'MANDATE WATCH' module (brit-mandate cards with red deadline accents); (h) a 'RECENT ACTIVITY' feed (brit-feed-row rows with time, text, player, gold tag); (i) a QUICK ACTIONS grid linking to Our Roster, Shortlist, Releases, On Loan/Returnees, War Room, AI Scout, Contacts, Requests, Contract Finisher, Tasks, The Tunnel. Every section's tap targets must navigate to the relevant screen (even if that screen is a later feature's stub for now). Seed realistic placeholder data (plausible footballer names, Israeli/European clubs, dates) in app.js — no real PII, no real photos (use grayscale gradient + initials/SVG silhouette treatment).

Add a global decorative but tasteful set of micro-interactions reused across the app: hairline underline grows on tap/hover for mono links, gold focus-arrow nudges, card lift on press, and a subtle entrance stagger for module rows. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
acceptance_criteria: Opening docs/mobile-prototype/index.html in a browser shows a realistic phone frame containing the running prototype on an editorial paper backdrop, with no uncaught JS console errors.

The design uses the exact .brit-room tokens, the fractalNoise paper-grain overlay is visible, mastheads render in condensed uppercase Oswald, and micro-labels render in uppercase DM Mono — degrading to Impact/monospace fallbacks when fonts are blocked.
The BritLoader splash animates (rotating rings + pulsing core + dots) and auto-advances to the Login screen, which then transitions via the loader into the Dashboard on submit.

The Dashboard renders all nine sections (masthead, signals, birthdays, our assets marquee, matchweek rail, pending-decisions black module, mandate watch, recent activity, quick actions) and is vertically scrollable within the phone frame.

Tapping a quick action, a nav tab, the More sheet, an OUR ASSETS card, or a matchweek stop navigates to another screen with a visible slide/fade transition, and a back affordance returns to the previous screen.
Operating the platform switch slides the pill thumb and retints the entire UI from gold (Men) to teal (Youth) to rose (Women).
verification: Open docs/mobile-prototype/index.html with the agent-browser/playwright headless browser at a mobile viewport (430x932), wait ~2.5s, and snapshot top-of-fold; confirm the phone frame + editorial theme render and the console reports no errors.
Programmatically (or via the snapshot) confirm the loader auto-advances and the dashboard masthead text 'GOOD MORNING' is present.
Trigger the platform switch via a click eval and confirm data-platform changes and an accent color (gold->teal->rose) is applied to a known element.
findings: Built the self-contained prototype under docs/mobile-prototype/: index.html (phone-frame showcase with dynamic island, status bar, live clock, art-direction rail, jump buttons + platform chips), app.html (iframe-mounted app shell), styles.css (full .brit-room design system ported verbatim + platform retints + all component CSS + loader/login/dashboard/chrome), app.js (seed data + hash/stack router with slide-push/fade transitions + chrome + loader + login + dashboard + dossier + breadth stubs), showcase.js. VERIFIED with agent-browser (playwright power blocks file:// and its browser is network-isolated from the shell's localhost, so agent-browser over file:// was used): loader auto-advances (~2s) -> cinematic Login ('THE MANAGEMENT ROOM.') -> submit runs loader -> Dashboard renders ALL nine sections (masthead 'GOOD AFTERNOON, LIOR.', 5 signals, 3 TODAY birthdays, 5 OUR ASSETS focus cards, 5 MATCHWEEK stops, PENDING black module w/ 3 approvals, 4 MANDATE cards, 4 RECENT ACTIVITY rows, 12 QUICK ACTIONS). Platform switch retints verified: Men gold rgb(164,125,67) -> Youth teal rgb(47,125,110) -> Women rose rgb(176,95,126), data-platform swaps on app root. Navigation verified: tab switch (fade), roster row -> dossier push (back affordance appears, header title updates), back pop returns. Zero console errors across loader/login/dashboard/nav and on the showcase page. Grain overlay, Oswald mastheads, DM Mono kickers all render; Google Fonts linked with Impact/Helvetica/monospace fallbacks. NOTES for later features: (1) breadth screens (players full roster, war room, shortlist, market radar, releases, club changes, contract finisher, returnees, contacts, requests, ai scout, tunnel, tasks) are working lightweight stubs routed via SCREENS.stub + SCREENS.players/dossier -- replace with full screens. (2) Under file:// the showcase iframe is cross-origin-isolated so the launcher's postMessage jump buttons/platform-sync are no-ops (handled by try/catch, no errors); they work when served same-origin (GitHub Pages /mocks). Users still drive the app by tapping inside the frame, or open app.html directly. (3) agent-browser did not apply a mobile viewport width in this env (captures came out at 1280w) but layout is mobile-first and renders correctly inside the 390px phone frame; verify in a real mobile browser. (4) Verification method note: driving the login via requestSubmit() in an eval intermittently blanked the agent-browser page to about:blank; real .login-enter clicks work -- use clicks, not form eval, when testing.
